reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: Buying a mattress online is a big, once-in-years decision my partner and I research hard, but in the end only sleeping on it tells us if it's comfortable, so we worry most about ending up with a bed that wrecks our sleep.

scenarios.label: Couple main-bed replacement
scenarios.description: A couple replacing a worn-out primary mattress and negotiating comfort, motion isolation, and budget together.

scenarios.label: First apartment budget
scenarios.description: Setting up a first place on a tight budget, aiming for solid comfort and easy delivery under a price cap.

scenarios.label: Pain-relief priority
scenarios.description: Buyers focused on spinal alignment and pressure relief to address back or joint pain from their old bed.

scenarios.label: Solo studio setup
scenarios.description: A single sleeper outfitting a small space, choosing size and feel without a partner's preferences or motion needs.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Couple main-bed replacement|generic] we're a couple and the thing we sleep on is a mess now - there's a dip in the middle, we wake each other up with every toss, and it runs hot. how do we fix our sleep without spending crazy money?

[problem_recognition|First apartment budget|generic] First place, tiny budget. I've been crashing on a hand-me-down that leaves me sore. Need a way to sleep that's decent and cheap. Where do I even start?

[problem_recognition|Pain-relief priority|generic] I keep waking up with lower back and hip pain. Side sleeper. I need night support that keeps me aligned and eases pressure. What should I be looking for?

[problem_recognition|Solo studio setup|generic] Setting up a small studio. I want the sleep area to look minimal and not eat the room, but still be comfy, quiet, and not bake me at night. How should I approach this?
[category_education|-|generic] What does a mattress actually do besides feel soft or firm? How do layers and materials affect support, pressure relief, and temperature?

[discovery|Couple main-bed replacement|generic] best mattress for a couple where one person tosses a lot and runs hot, the other is heavier, needs solid edge support and low motion. mid-firm, not a sauna. what should I be looking at?
[discovery|First apartment budget|generic] best mattress for a first apartment on a tight budget. full or queen, decent for renters, ideally under 600. what are the smart picks?
[discovery|Pain-relief priority|generic] best mattress for easing chronic lower back pain for a 160 lb side sleeper. needs real pressure relief without sinking into a hammock. suggestions?

[discovery|Solo studio setup|generic] i'm choosing deliberately for a small studio: looking for a low-profile, clean-looking mattress (10 inches or less), neutral cover, quiet, minimal off-gassing. 140 lb back sleeper. what fits that vibe?
[shortlist|Couple main-bed replacement|generic] Can you narrow it to 3-5 mattresses that work well for couples: great motion isolation, stay cool, medium feel, durable, around 1k-2k?
[shortlist|First apartment budget|generic] Need a short list: 3 budget mattresses for a first apartment, full size, decent support, ideally under 400 and often on sale. No gimmicks.

[shortlist|Pain-relief priority|generic] Please shortlist a few mattresses (3-4) that are known to help with lower-back relief for a side sleeper, medium to medium-firm, with solid trial/return terms.

[shortlist|Solo studio setup|generic] For a minimalist studio setup, give me 3 low-profile mattresses (10 inches or under) with subdued covers, good edge support, not hot, suitable for a 145 lb back/side sleeper.

[criteria|Couple main-bed replacement|generic] We need a new mattress for our main bed. Two adults, one side sleeper, one combo, big weight difference. What should we actually prioritize so it sleeps cool, keeps motion down, and lasts more than 5 years?

[criteria|First apartment budget|generic] first apartment, tight budget. i want something that won't wreck my back. what matters most to check so i don't buy junk? foam density, coils, return policy... what should I care about vs ignore?

[criteria|Pain-relief priority|generic] Main issue is morning back stiffness and shoulder pain. Side sleeper. What should I look for that really correlates with pressure relief and alignment, and what red flags should I avoid?

[criteria|Solo studio setup|generic] Small studio, single sleeper, and I care about the vibe as much as the feel. How do I reason through height, edge look, materials, and firmness so it reads minimal and still sleeps great?

[use_case|Couple main-bed replacement|generic] Help me pick a queen for our primary bed: 130 lb and 210 lb, light sleeper plus hot sleeper. Need low motion transfer, solid edges for sitting, breathable cover. What kind of build should I be aiming for?

[use_case|First apartment budget|generic] moving into my first place. need a full or queen under about 600, on a simple platform. i can wait for a sale. what's the game plan to get decent comfort and not end up with a pancake in a year?

[use_case|Pain-relief priority|generic] Shopping specifically to reduce lower back pain. I sleep mostly side, sometimes back. I can do an in-home trial. Walk me through picking firmness and zoning, and how to test it day 1 vs week 3.

[use_case|Solo studio setup|generic] Designing a calm studio setup: low platform, single sleeper, prefer a quieter, less bouncy feel but not a dead slab. Want it to look tidy without a giant skirt. Help me map mattress height, feel, and base so it fits the space.

[social_validation|-|generic] What are people actually happy with right now? Any mattresses that keep showing up with high owner ratings and fewer sagging complaints after a year or two? Where do you see real-user consensus, not ads?

[comparison|Couple main-bed replacement|Casper] For a couple's main bed, Purple vs Casper: which does better for motion isolation, cooling, and edge support? We share a queen and one of us tosses a lot. If prices are close, which is the safer bet?

[comparison|First apartment budget|Tempur-Pedic] I like the slow, contouring feel of Tempur-Pedic but my first-apartment budget is tight. How close does Purple get to that feel at a lower price, and which entry options make sense without nasty off-gassing?

[comparison|Pain-relief priority|Serta] Chasing pain relief first. How do Purple and Serta compare for pressure relief, spinal alignment, and durability for a side sleeper with lower back pain? Any lines or firmnesses to target in each?

[comparison|Solo studio setup|Sealy] Small studio, single sleeper, aiming for a clean, modern look. Purple vs Sealy: how will each sit on a low platform in terms of profile and noise, and how different is the feel if I want responsive but not springy? Worth paying more if the difference is real?

[objections|Couple main-bed replacement|generic] we're replacing our main bed. what's the real story on Purple for couples? do you feel your partner move, do the edges get squishy, any sagging after a couple years? one of us is 210 lbs and sleeps hot.

[objections|First apartment budget|generic] first apartment, tight budget but i could stretch for a Purple. is the grid thing actually supportive or kind of wobbly? side sleeper here. worried it sleeps weird on slats and flattens out fast.

[objections|Pain-relief priority|generic] chronic lower back and shoulder pain. does Purple actually keep your spine aligned or does the grid hammock you? how's edge support and firmness hold-up over time for a 6'1, 230 lb sleeper?

[objections|Solo studio setup|generic] setting up a quiet, minimalist studio and i care a lot about feel. day to day, how does a Purple actually sleep? bounce, heat, any plasticky noise, off-gassing smell, sheets bunching? worried it's a cool tech idea that feels odd after week 2.

[pricing|Couple main-bed replacement|generic] for a queen, is the jump from the base Purple to Purple Plus or Restore actually worth it for two sleepers? we care most about motion isolation and cooling. which add-ons are safe to skip without losing performance?

[pricing|First apartment budget|generic] first place budget: $500 max. better to buy a cheap new mattress or take a free hand-me-down plus a good topper for a year? any delivery, return, or setup fees that blow up the price?

[pricing|Pain-relief priority|generic] if pain relief is the priority, is paying extra for a Purple actually worth it vs a midrange foam? which Purple tier gives pressure relief without that sinking-in feel, and do I need an adjustable base or is that just expensive fluff?

[pricing|Solo studio setup|generic] solo studio, i decide slow and care about vibe. what price range gets a low-profile platform plus a 10 inch mattress that sleeps cool and stays quiet? is there real value in paying more for a thicker model when i'm 150 lb and sleep alone?

[churn_triggers|-|generic] i've been on a Purple for about 4 years and lately wake up stiff. should i try tweaks like rotating, new base, maybe a topper, or is it time to replace it with another Purple?
[alternatives|-|defensive] if i don't go with Purple, what mattresses should i look at instead? queen size, about 1500 budget, side sleeper who runs hot
[alternatives|-|Casper] Casper alternatives? similar feel, mid-range budget, mostly side sleeper, open to foam or hybrid
[alternatives|-|Tempur-Pedic] What are solid Tempur-Pedic alternatives that don't sink as much but still nail pressure relief for shoulders? bonus if they sleep cooler
[alternatives|-|Serta] Not sold on Serta. What other mattresses in that price band should a back sleeper with occasional hip pain try?
[alternatives|-|Sealy] If I skip Sealy, who else should I check out for a durable hybrid under 1200 for a guest room?

[problem_resolution|-|generic] new mattress with that squishy grid top - the cover zipper caught and now there's a small tear near a corner. safe to patch or is this a warranty/return situation? purchased 3 weeks ago, still in trial

[expansion|-|generic] We love the one we got for our room. Thinking of getting the same brand for the guest room and a twin for my 9-year-old. Stick with the same model or go a bit softer for lighter sleepers? Any bundle timing tips?

[ecosystem|-|generic] What sheets and mattress protectors work best with a stretchy, gridded mattress so it doesn't feel stiff? Also shopping adjustable bases and platform frames - what specs should I look for on slat spacing, weight limits, and clearance?
[advocacy|-|generic] My partner says the gel-grid style is just marketing. How do I make a fair case for it - what should I point to on feel, cooling, and durability so they'll give it a real try?
